title: AURA FC 3D — Street & Stadium Football

qualityGate.note: Typecheck clean. Remote browser evidence pending — do not promote before aura-evidence/showcase-aura-fc-3d captures land.

routeGate.claim: Five-a-side broadcast football on a deterministic ball sim (dribble/trap/loose/flight FSM, curl, posts, boards). Six re-tintable venues from a walled favela cage to the Glacier dome, eight club identities, Shootout Lab + Touch Lab, a 32-team World Circuit (group → knockouts), Player Studio, CPU-vs-CPU demo, broadcast camera director, DOM score bug + ticker, juice/VFX + audio pipeline. Publishes window.__AURA3D_GAME_EVIDENCE__ / __AURA3D_GAME__ / __gameEvidence / __auraEvidence.

assetHonesty: Match ball, floodlight pylons, scoreboard gantry, glacier dome and hero trophy are bespoke Meshy GLBs generated for this route (artifacts/meshy/fc-* provenance, admitted via assets import-meshy — no shared/defunct-game assets). Athletes, pitch, goals, stands, crowd and cage are route-local primitives.
